title: Why he chose the clarinet; hearing Professor Dockett in Chicago
summary: He simply liked the instrument, heard clarinet in New Orleans and again at the State Theatre in Chicago after the family moved.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Why did you want to take up the clarinet? Why did you like that better than the others?
I just liked the particular instrument.
You don't remember when you first heard it was at the New Orleans bands, I guess, and you just liked it from back to the…
Yeah, I heard New Orleans and I, when we moved to Chicago, I heard Professor Dockett at this theatre. The theatre, so that's… And I liked the sound of the instrument.
Called the State Theatre. Yeah, I think that name was going around. Oh, yeah.
